items.title: Tens of thousands flee fires in France, blazes merge outside Madrid
items.description: France orders total evacuation of Cap Ferret peninsula as Spain declares national emergency for the first time over fires.

items.title: US and Iran trade strikes after Trump vows 'major military punishment'
items.description: The strikes came after President Donald Trump vowed "major military punishment" for Tehran and its Houthi allies in Yemen over moves to block a second major international shipping route.

items.title: Singer Chris Brown pleads guilty to affray over London nightclub incident
items.description: US singer Chris Brown has pleaded guilty to affray over an altercation in a London nightclub in a fight that injured a music producer with a glass bottle.

items.title: Russian missile strike kills 10 at Ukraine defence industry event
items.description: A Russian ballistic missile strike has killed 10 people and injured almost 100 at a defence industry event near Kyiv, as the Kremlin says it will keep fighting while awaiting new US peace proposals.

items.title: Bali bans two Dutch men alleged to have hosted discriminatory run club
items.description: Bali's Immigration department has banned two Dutch expats from Indonesia for organising a run club event '"fraught with discrimination against local residents".

items.title: New report reveals what triggered SA's catastrophic algal bloom crisis
items.description: A new report reveals what caused South Australia's most devastating algal bloom crisis — 18 months after it first appeared on the state's waters.

items.title: Live: Aussies chasing Comm Games swimming gold as finals get underway
items.description: It's officially day one of the Commonwealth Games in Glasgow, with the first swimming medals up for grabs in the pool. Follow live.

items.title: Defence minister confirms former senior naval officer faces court martial
items.description: A former senior naval officer will face charges in a military trial set down for up to six weeks from September 14 with the military court ordering their identity remain suppressed.

items.title: New Trump tariffs 'make it harder for Australian businesses to compete'
items.description: The Business Council of Australia says a new tariff will make it harder for Australian businesses to compete in the US and could reduce investment.

items.title: Why did Trump slap a 12.5pc tariff on Australian imports?
items.description: The tariffs are supposed to combat forced labour, but one expert says the US president was just looking for another legal way to tax foreign imports.

items.title: President Trump Announces U.S. Military Airstrike in Venezuela
items.description: President Trump states the U.S. military conducted its first known airstrike inside Venezuela targeting a dock where drugs were allegedly loaded onto boats[1][2][4].

items.title: Trump Meets Netanyahu at Mar-a-Lago for Gaza Ceasefire Phase Two Talks
items.description: President Trump met with Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu to discuss advancing phase two of the Gaza ceasefire, including reconstruction and responses to Iran[1][4].

items.title: Feds Launch Massive Taxpayer Fraud Probe in Minnesota After Viral Video
items.description: Federal agencies including DHS, FBI, and ICE investigate $110 million in suspected fraud at Minnesota child care centers following a viral YouTube video[3].

items.title: Americans Express Widespread Opposition to AI Data Centers
items.description: Public backlash against AI infrastructure data centers grows, with protests and demands for bans influencing Democratic Party strategies for future elections[3].

items.title: Elon Musk's Humanoid Robot Vision: China Poised to Lead Production
items.description: China prioritizes humanoid robots in tech race with U.S., ramping up production while warning of industry bubble and potential bottlenecks[3].

items.title: Trump-Putin Call Amid Ukraine-Russia Tensions Over Peace Plan
items.description: President Trump spoke with Putin amid ongoing Ukraine conflict, with Russia reevaluating peace plan tenets after Ukrainian denials[1].

items.title: Democratic Gubernatorial Candidates in Wisconsin Focus on Inflation and Trump
items.description: Seven Democrats vying for Wisconsin governor blame economic issues on Trump and emphasize affordability ahead of 2026 primary[3].
